title: Fermentation Pathways Comparison
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AP Biology
description: Interactive step-through MicroSim comparing lactic acid and alcoholic fermentation with NAD+ recycling, ATP tally, and organism fun facts

learningObjectives: Compare lactic acid and alcoholic fermentation in terms of reactants and products
Explain why fermentation is necessary when oxygen is absent
Identify the shared purpose of NAD+ regeneration in both pathways

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through narration with pathway focus toggle
keyQuestions: Why do both fermentation pathways yield only 2 ATP per glucose?
What is the real purpose of fermentation if not ATP production?
How do the waste products differ between the two pathways?
commonMisconceptions: Fermentation produces extra ATP beyond glycolysis (it does not)
Lactic acid fermentation only occurs in animals (bacteria use it too)
Alcoholic fermentation and lactic acid fermentation are completely different processes (they share glycolysis and NAD+ recycling)
assessmentOpportunities: Trace NAD+ recycling through each pathway
Predict which organisms use which pathway and why
